entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: Thank you for visiting.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: Currently, we are holding an exhibition of[n]the works of the great artist Madarame.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: Madarame can always be found on the[n]cutting edge of the Japanese art world.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: This exhibit attempts to express and[n]share the appeal of Madarame's works.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: His unique ideas, unrestrained by[n]preconceived notions...

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: ...give rise to new possibilities in the[n]Nihonga art form.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: Not only has he helped pioneer new[n]developments in the art world...

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: ...but he has also dedicated himself to[n]training the next generation of artists.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: He is an irreplaceable figure in the[n]modern world of Japanese art.

entries.speaker: Voice
entries.en: The eyes of the world are on Madarame.[n]How will his next move change the art[n]world?

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: This work, attentively painted with[n]delicate strokes...

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: ...is noted for its use of deep, intricate[n]colors.

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: The features of the model are captured[n]masterfully.

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: It's almost as if they were right there[n]in front of you.

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: Not only does it exude an imposing[n]presence...

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: ...but it has a mysterious, unique allure...

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: ...that draws in and captivates all who[n]look at it.

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: It has an everlasting appeal...

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: ...that makes you feel like you could[n]gaze upon it forever.

entries.speaker: Announcement
entries.en: It would not be an overstatement to[n]call this painting "perfect."
